description: This file defines a CodeHandler class responsible for managing code span editing and rendering within a markdown editor in an Android application. It implements the EditHandler interface to handle code block styling, persistence, and markdown span handling.

classes.name: CodeHandler
classes.description: A class that handles code span customization and persistence in a markdown editor, implementing the EditHandler interface for CodeSpan objects.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler with the theme configuration from the Markwon instance.

methods.name: configurePersistedSpans
methods.description: Configures which span types should be persisted during editing; in this case, CodeSpan.

methods.name: handleMarkdownSpan
methods.description: Handles the application of markdown spans to the editable text when a code span is detected.

methods.name: markdownSpanType
methods.description: Returns the class type of the span this handler manages, which is CodeSpan.
